objectives.text: Count a group of up to 10 real objects by touching them one by one
Identify the written numbers 1 through 10 in order
Combine two physical groups of objects together to find the total amount.
Count up to five total objects to find the sum.
Explain how putting groups together makes a bigger group.
Count groups of 5 real objects using your fingers or tally marks
Identify the number pattern when counting by fives up to 100
Explain why numbers when counting by fives always end in 0 or 5
Model two-digit addition problems using base-ten blocks or counters to group tens and ones.
Explain when and why regrouping is necessary once the ones column reaches 10 or more.
Solve two-digit addition equations requiring regrouping in the standard algorithm format.
Listen to spoken words and isolate their beginning sounds using your voice
Match words that start with the exact same beginning sound
